source: European Parliament hemicycle (Strasbourg layout), numbering validated against the official plan
numbering_rule: Seats are numbered sequentially: circle 1 (innermost) to circle 14 (outermost), left to right within each circle (Council side -> Commission side). Empty (light grey) seats and the Council/Commission benches ARE numbered; the invisible aisle gaps are NOT numbered. slot_in_circle_with_gaps places every circle on a common angular frame: slot 1 of every circle is at the same angle (deep left, level with the innermost Council bench), so circles whose seats start further in have leading/trailing invisible slots -- many of them on the outer circles.

frame_deg.note: slot s of a circle sits at angle left - (s-1)*seat_pitch_deg; all circles share this frame, so outer circles have many leading/trailing invisible slots
